files_changed.summary: Members-only live:{sessionId} topic: select + insert for broadcast and presence; ws:/user: get no insert, so they stay database-sent only (g6).
Re-export RealtimeChannel alongside SupabaseClient so presence code never imports supabase-js (I21).
Send policy: one message per interval, only on real movement (RULE-20) (g2).
THE EXCEPTION: paintCursors adds one non-interactive circle per cursor (g2).
Ref + paint lifecycle; hands paint to the container once; no React state (g2).
openLiveChannel (private live: topic, presence key) + presenceToPeers (g1/g6).
Peers + leader indicator as state, cursors via ref + throttle; stroke-end clears (g1/g2/g4).
5 tests: peers, leader indicator set/clear, ignore non-leader/other page, throttle, close.

decisions: DB-Q9 / the migration number: the plan's 0005_live_topic.sql collides with 0005_storage_artifacts.sql (task 003); 0006_live_topic.sql is the next free number (analyze.json NEW-1). The policy mirrors 0004's proven ws: shape, uses realtime.messages.extension in ('broadcast','presence'), and grants INSERT only on live: — so a client still cannot forge a database-change event on ws:/user:.

The live channel lives in features/presence and imports getSupabase + type RealtimeChannel from shared/lib/supabase (I21 intact); it is a separate channel from 007's ws:/user: one, and uses the same private-channel + presence-key discipline.

Cursors are never React state (RULE-20): usePeerCursors hands an imperative paint() to the container once; the container calls it from the presence hook's ref. Presence (who is here) and the leader indicator are low-frequency, so they are state (analyze.json NEW-2).
The leader indicator clears on an explicit cursor with drawing:false (the stroke end) and has a 1.2s idle fallback if that frame is lost (g4).
g3 (broadcast-from-database applied via applyRemote) is 007's path and is not duplicated; presence adds no second render path.
The presence layer is not yet mounted in the shell (no route renders PeerCursors or LeaderDrawing) because the document-view route still does not exist; the leaf and hook are ready for it.
